title: Magnetic field due to current
ques: What happens to a magnetic compass needle when it is brought near a wire carrying an electric current? What does this prove?

answer.content:
The magnetic compass needle will show a **deflection** when brought near the current-carrying wire.

This proves that an electric current produces a **magnetic field** around it.

explanation: This introduces the fundamental connection between electricity and magnetism (Oersted's experiment).

title: Electromagnetic induction

answer.content: **Electromagnetic Induction** is the phenomenon of generating an induced electric current in a closed circuit by changing the magnetic field passing through it (e.g., by moving a magnet into or out of a coil of wire).

explanation: This covers the reverse phenomenon of the previous topic: creating electricity from magnetism (Faraday's discovery).

title: Electric motor principle
ques: What is the underlying principle on which an **Electric Motor** works?

answer.content:
An Electric Motor works on the principle that when a **current-carrying rectangular coil** is placed in a **magnetic field**, it experiences a force that makes it rotate continuously. 

This device converts **electrical energy into mechanical energy**.

explanation: This tests the practical application of the magnetic effect of electric current.

title: Electric generator working
ques: How does an **Electric Generator** differ from an Electric Motor in terms of energy conversion?

answer.content:
An Electric Generator performs the exact opposite function of a motor.

While a motor converts electrical energy into mechanical energy, an **Electric Generator converts mechanical energy into electrical energy** using the principle of electromagnetic induction.

explanation: This contrasts two major electrical machines, highlighting their opposite roles in energy conversion.
